rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; data from the REST-meta-MDD project (multiple scanning sites). Site 4 and Site 25 were excluded; sites with fewer than 10 MDD or 10 HC were also excluded. HBR was used to accommodate site-related variability.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022). Site 4 and Site 25 were excluded since Site 4's participants were duplicated with those from Site 14, and Site 25 contained an excessive number of late-onset depression cases"; "hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR) was employed in the HC cohort to develop a normative model... HBR allows for the imposition of a common prior distribution across multiple sites to estimate site-specific yet interrelated means and variances, thus accommodating signal and noise variability in multisite data"
rci1_using_msad.location: Sun2025.pdf.md: 2.1. Participants, L74; 2.3. Capturing individual deviations from normative models, L92

rci2_using_epd.detail: REST-meta-MDD, a publicly accessible multi-site dataset, was used as the reference data source for normative model construction
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: REST-meta-MDD dataset provided by the DIRECT consortium; publicly accessible at http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "These data were obtained from a publicly accessible dataset from the REST-meta-MDD project (Yan et al., 2019) provided by the DIRECT consortium (Chen et al., 2022)."; "The data used during the present study could be obtained from open dataset (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; all 822 HC were used to train the final normative models. 10-fold cross-validation was first performed for model evaluation, then normative models were trained on all HC data.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "822 healthy controls (HC, mean age: 35.045 ± 13.336 years, 331 males and 491 females)"; "the normative models were trained on all HC data and later applied to MDD patients."
